notablePrerequisites:
Identity Thief does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block Medomai token.
description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a copy of Identity Thief with haste.
Attack with the Identity Thief token, triggering it and exiling Medomai the Ageless until end of turn.
the Identity Thief token will deal combat damage as a copy of Medomai the Ageless, granting you an extra turn.
At the end of the turn, Medomai the Ageless returns to the battlefield.
Sacrifice the token.
Repeat for infinite turns.
